title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Experience:** 7\+ years

**Department:** Customer Success Management

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. We are looking for a technically savvy customer success manager who possesses a strong drive for results. One should also be able to handle customer complaints and requests. **Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop and manage client relationships.
* Develop and manage relationships with the project team/internal team.

* Responsible for growing customer accounts by identifying new opportunities in existing accounts.
* Meet with customers on a regular basis
* Manage billing disputes and upgrade/downgrade requests
* Provide feedback to the Delivery team on how customers' challenges
* Ensure all contractual obligations are kept up to date, including payment terms.
* Minimize customer churn.

**Required Skills:**


* Overall 7\+ years of experience in IT industry
* Atleast 3\+ years of experience purely in the Customer Success role.
* Highly organized and able to multitask.
* Self\-driven and proactive nature.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrate leadership qualities.
* Ability to identify and manage risks
* Deep understanding of technology.
* Knowledge of customer success processes.
* Experience in document creation.
* Patient and active listener.
* Passion for service.

**Why Join Us:**


* Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, work\-from\-home options.
* Free health insurance.
* Office facility with a fully\-equipped game zone, in\-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.

title: Manager, IT Business & Product Management
description:
**Our Digital Transformation**


The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.

**Role Overview**


The **Manager, IT Business \& Product Management** will help connect business priorities with technology solutions that deliver measurable value in Manufacturing IT environment. This role acts as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, vendors, and service providers. The role is responsible for translating business needs into product priorities, roadmaps, portfolio decisions, and technology outcomes, while supporting effective escalation management and value realization. This position is ideal for a business\-facing information technology professional who understands how to balance customer needs, operational priorities, workplace technology, manufacturing environments, vendor delivery, financial discipline, and digital transformation. The successful candidate will bring strong product management capability, practical technology fluency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive results in a cross\-functional manufacturing environment. This role helps ensuring technology products and services are aligned to business capability needs, governed effectively, and continuously improved through data, insight, and collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, and technology partners.

**What You will do for us**

* Lead business engagement by partnering with business stakeholders to understand priorities, pain points, operational needs, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvement.
* Translate business requirements into product priorities, technology outcomes, roadmap plans, and investment recommendations that support measurable business value.
* Develop and manage product roadmaps aligned to business capability needs, portfolio priorities, operational readiness, and financial planning.
* Own product outcomes, adoption, user value, business impact, and product\-related escalations for assigned technology services or capabilities.
* Use governance, prioritization methods, and performance insights to improve product outcomes, business alignment, and decision\-making.
* Assess the business and product impact of incidents, ensuring appropriate stakeholder communication, escalation support, and alignment with vendors and technical resolution teams.
* Support change prioritization, release readiness, business adoption, governance decisions, and stakeholder alignment for technology changes.
* Support business capability development and digital product evolution through value\-based investment decisions and coordination across delivery, architecture, finance, and operations teams.
* Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers that support product delivery, roadmap execution, workplace technology, manufacturing solutions, or business outcomes.
* Coordinate with management teams, vendors, and service providers to resolve issues, support service quality, and improve delivery performance.
* Use business, product, adoption, financial, operational, and value realization metrics to determine priorities and influence portfolio decisions.
* Apply artificial intelligence insights and data\-driven analysis to support prioritization, product decisions, service improvement, and business value creation.
* Ensure product priorities and delivery decisions align with governance, risk, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology standards.
* Support business case development, investment planning, portfolio prioritization, value realization, and management of operating expense and capital expenditure budgets.
* Influence product portfolio priorities, business capability investment, and strategic technology planning within the relevant business and technology scope.
* Bring awareness of manufacturing systems and applications to support operational environments, business continuity, and practical technology decision\-making.

**Requirements and Qualifications Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience working in Information Technology, preferably in business\-facing technology, product management, workplace technology, manufacturing technology, service delivery, or a related environment.
* Practical knowledge of end\-user and workplace technology services, including personal computers, deskside support, Microsoft and Apple operating systems, remote desktop protocol, virtual desktop infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Knowledge of output management solutions, including multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.
* Familiarity with manufacturing systems, manufacturing applications, or technology used to support production or bottling environments.
* Experience in product management, business relationship management, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and agile delivery.
* Experience leading a team or workstream, motivating others, driving execution, and delivering results in a cross\-functional environment.
* Proven ability to develop information technology solutions that address complex business problems and enable measurable outcomes.
* Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to translate stakeholder needs into product priorities, technology requirements, and actionable plans.
* Experience coordinating with management, vendors, service providers, and technology partners to support delivery quality, service performance, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology governance, prioritization, change readiness, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and service management practices.
* Ability to use data, metrics, analytics, and financial indicators to guide prioritization, measure adoption, and support continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and automation concepts, with the ability to apply insights appropriately to product management, decision\-making, and service improvement.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience supporting business cases, investment planning, operating expense budgets, capital expenditure budgets, and value realization.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across levels and functions.
* Structured, organized, pragmatic, and practical working style with strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and sound decision\-making.
* Full professional English proficiency, including clear written and verbal communication.
* Bottler, manufacturing, consumer goods, or operational technology experience strongly preferred.

title: Senior Account Manager- US Market
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Model:** Fully In\-Person  
**Shift:** 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST (Night Shift in India)  
**Experience:** 5\+ years in Account Management  
**Market:** United States  
**Languages:** English, Gujarati and Hindi  
**US/Canada Customer Experience:** Preferred

About SwiftSku

SwiftSku is a Y Combinator\-backed early\-stage startup helping family\-owned convenience stores across America thrive.

Our co\-founder, Mit Patel, grew up helping his family run their convenience store, giving SwiftSku a deep understanding of the challenges these businesses face. We combine a mobile app with a Point of Sale ecosystem to make running a convenience store easier and more efficient.

We are looking for people who want to make a meaningful impact, move quickly, take ownership and help family businesses succeed across America and beyond.

About the Role

We are looking for a high\-ownership Senior Account Manager who is excited to work in a fast\-paced startup environment, build trusted customer relationships and help convenience store owners get maximum value from SwiftSku.

If you are smart, coachable, customer\-focused and motivated by success, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage customer accounts and build strong, long\-term relationships.
* Conduct regular check\-ins and structured account reviews to keep customers engaged, supported and consistently receiving value.
* Help customers quickly reach their first value milestone and guide them towards deeper adoption of new features.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products or support more store locations.
* Collect high\-quality customer references that contribute to new revenue.
* Identify early signs of dissatisfaction and take proactive action to prevent downgrades and customer churn.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Sales and Leadership teams to share customer insights and improve the overall customer experience.
* Maintain accurate documentation, CRM hygiene and consistent follow\-ups across the entire account portfolio.

Key Requirements

* Minimum 5 years of Account Management experience.
* Willingness to work fully in person from our Ahmedabad office during the required shift of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Verbal fluency in Gujarati and Hindi is mandatory.
* Experience managing customers from the United States or Canada is strongly preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to calm frustrated customers, communicate clearly and drive positive outcomes.
* Excellent listening skills and a strong customer\-first mindset.
* High level of mental resilience and adaptability in a fast\-changing, early\-stage startup environment.
* Eagerness to learn, openness to coaching and willingness to adopt new strategies, tools and processes.
* Tech\-savvy and comfortable learning new technology platforms.
* Experience driving software adoption or helping customers get greater value from software products is a plus.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams such as Support, Product and Sales.

Why Join SwiftSku?

* **Merit\-Based Career Growth:** Career progression is based on your ability to create meaningful business outcomes and continuously improve—not simply on seniority.
* **Global Exposure:** Work directly with our American team and customers.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join an ambitious team that works hard and wins together.
* **Continuous Growth:** Benefit from coaching, offsites, ambitious goals and opportunities designed to support your professional development.

Pay: ₹90,000\.00 \- ₹230,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
